verdict.rationale: Ente Auth has a dedicated bulk-import feature and docs listing native support for many 2FA providers (2FAS, Aegis, andOTP, Bitwarden, Google Authenticator, LastPass, Proton, Raivo OTP) plus conversion paths for others like Authy, with community testimony confirming easy export/import migration from Aegis. missing for 10: no independent hands-on walkthrough of the bulk-import UI itself, only docs and one community mention.
